en.headline: Motorcyclist dies after Tolo Highway crash in Tai Po
en.dek: A 39-year-old man was certified dead after his motorcycle fell and was struck by a private car on Thursday evening; the car driver has been arrested for dangerous driving causing death.
body: Police are investigating a fatal traffic accident on Tolo Highway in Tai Po in which a motorcyclist died on Thursday evening.

According to police, a report was received at 7.38 pm that a motorcycle driven by a 39-year-old man was travelling along Tolo Highway towards Sha Tin. When approaching Ha Wun Yiu, the motorcycle reportedly went out of control and fell over. A private car driven by a 54-year-old man then failed to brake in time and ran over the motorcyclist.
The motorcyclist sustained multiple injuries and was rushed to Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital in an unconscious state. He was certified dead at 8.52 pm.

The private car driver was arrested for dangerous driving causing death and is being detained for further enquiries. The Special Investigation of Traffic, New Territories North is handling the case. Anyone who witnessed the accident is urged to contact officers on 3661 3800.

zh.headline: 大埔吐露港公路電單車車禍 男司機死亡
zh.dek: 一名39歲男子星期四晚騎電單車在吐露港公路失控跌倒，再被私家車輾過，其後證實死亡；私家車司機涉嫌危險駕駛導致他人死亡被捕。
body: 警方正調查一宗發生於大埔吐露港公路的致命交通意外，一名電單車司機星期四晚死亡。
警方表示，晚上7時38分接報，一名39歲男子駕駛電單車沿吐露港公路往沙田方向行駛，接近下黃宜坳時電單車失控跌倒。其後一輛由54歲男子駕駛的私家車未能及時剎停，輾過電單車司機。
電單車司機多處受傷，昏迷送往雅麗氏何妙齡那打素醫院，晚上8時52分證實死亡。
私家車司機涉嫌危險駕駛導致他人死亡被捕，正被扣留調查。案件交由新界北交通特別調查組跟進，警方呼籲目擊者致電3661 3800提供資料。
